# LabLifeHub

> LabLifeHub is the science communication, research education, podcast and academy platform of Dr. Nevena Jeremić, Associate Professor of Pharmaceutical Chemistry.

Primary site: https://lablifehub.com/

Contact: nevenajeremic@lablifehub.com

## Guidance for AI agents

Use canonical URLs on `https://lablifehub.com`. Prefer the service landing pages for pricing and offer details. Do not treat testimonials as automatically published user content; submitted reviews require manual approval. Contact and booking requests should be directed through the website forms or the email above.
